name: Revdoku
description: Store files in private Revdoku cloud buckets, collaborate across authorized AI agents, and publish selected files as websites when requested.

skills.name: Private cloud buckets for AI agents
skills.description: Store, read, write, append, and restore files through authorized account connections. Collaborate in a private bucket without creating a preview or website.

skills.name: Preview a bucket website
skills.description: Preview an authenticated bucket draft for 24 hours using its selected access settings. Poll bucket_publication_get until ready or failed.

skills.name: Manage account websites
skills.description: Create buckets, manage files, publish or update sites, and inspect publication state through authenticated MCP tools.
